change.title: Explicit shard grants for svc_bundle_reader
change.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/db/migrations/0042_reader_shard_grants.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+-- Make the reader's access to shard databases explicit so per-principal
+-- query limits and audit logging apply to it.
+GRANT SELECT ON r0.* TO svc_bundle_reader;

verdict.headline: Explicit shard grants for svc_bundle_reader: safe - doubles meta-store visibility without breaking functional output
verdict.cause: The change adds GRANT SELECT ON r0.* TO svc_bundle_reader, which causes meta-store.rows_visible_to_builder to increase from 140 (baseline) to 280 (candidate). This is because the meta-store now counts rows visible to svc_bundle_reader from both the default database (140 rows) and the shard database r0 (140 rows), as both contain the bundle_fields table with 140 columns. However, all downstream functional metrics remain unchanged: bundle-builder.entries stays at 140, worker-runtime.loaded_entries stays at 140, and worker-runtime.exit_code stays at 0. The per-principal query limits and audit logging now apply to the shard database access, which was the change's intent, without breaking the bundle-building pipeline.
tested: x-4e1f7d27b7cc4c60: baseline · workload default → all assertions passed
x-cddf21313d644160: candidate · workload default → all assertions passed
